subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals be bounded inside the Codex dynamic-tool budget with actionable timeout results, or should OpenClaw instead preserve a longer operator approval window and change the Codex watchdog around it?
rationale: The decision affects how long generated-skill apply approvals remain actionable and whether timeout is treated as a safe pending-state veto or a longer blocking approval wait; automation should not choose that approval security contract while open PRs disagree on the shape.

options.title: Revise/Land The Broad Bounded Fix
options.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 or an equivalent patch that keeps approval fail-closed, fits inside the Codex tool budget, and adds live proof.

options.title: Use A Narrow Watchdog Fix
options.body: Prefer a smaller Codex watchdog adjustment such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 and leave popup details or timeout semantics to separate issues.

options.title: Choose Longer Approval TTL
options.body: Accept a longer operator review window such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315, but require the Codex watchdog and security proof to be aligned before merge.

recommendation.title: Revise/Land The Broad Bounded Fix
recommendation.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 or an equivalent patch that keeps approval fail-closed, fits inside the Codex tool budget, and adds live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current broad fix PR and is already assigned on the issue, so this is the best available owner for the approval-boundary choice.
